$comment: Every custom property that envUI 0.x or 1.0’s development defined and 1.0 no longer does, with what replaces it. prefixed: names that only take the --env- prefix. renamed: names that changed beyond the prefix, to a token (replacement) or a hand-written property (cssVariable); a name of 1.0’s development has the prefix already, and colorPropertyOf names the class of the component whose color property, which doesn't inherit, the cssVariable is, so the codemods report a declaration on a wrapper. aliases: the 0.7 alias tokens, removed with the prefix, each to the token of its role or the value of a fixed color. removed: names with no counterpart, with the token to use instead where there is one, which does not take its place as it is, such as a color token for a state opacity; a name that one token replaces as it is goes in renamed, which the codemods rewrite: every use, and a declaration only where no other name becomes the same token, since a declaration of a name merged into a token with others, such as --control-height-small, would set the token for all of them, so the codemods report it. The token build turns this into src/generated/token-migration.json, the map that the codemods (v1-classes) and the migration guide read.

--color-surface-base.note: 0.7 defined it, but envUI didn't read it; the raised surface is the role it named.

--color-surface-raised.note: 0.7 defined it, but envUI didn't read it; the raised surface is the role it named.

--color-text-subtle.note: A synonym of the muted text color, which envUI didn't read.

--color-control-text.note: A synonym of the control text color, which envUI didn't read.

--color-neutral-fill.note: 0.7 defined it, but envUI didn't read it; the neutral strong fill is the role it named.

--color-border-pressed.note: 0.7 defined it, but envUI didn't read it; the muted border's pressed state is the role it named.

--color-control-blue-hover.note: 0.7 defined it, but envUI didn't read it; the brand's strong fill is the role it named.

--color-control-blue-pressed.note: 0.7 defined it, but envUI didn't read it; the brand's strong fill is the role it named.

--color-fill-hover.note: 0.7 defined it, but envUI didn't read it; the neutral muted fill is the role it named.

--color-fill-pressed.note: 0.7 defined it, but envUI didn't read it; the neutral muted fill is the role it named.

--control-height-small.note: It always equalled --control-height, which every control reads now.

--control-height-compact.note: The small control height. For a compact app or region, set scale="compact" on its Theme instead.

--icon-button-size.note: An icon button is as tall as the other controls of its size.

--env-window-frame-title-bar-start.note: WindowFrame is gone: a TopBar with titleBar keeps clear of the window's controls at the start.

--env-window-frame-title-bar-end.note: WindowFrame is gone: a TopBar with titleBar keeps clear of the window's controls at the end.

--env-list-item-fill.note: A row's fill is the public color property --env-list-item-container, set on the row.

--env-toast-fill.note: A toast's fill is the public color property --env-toast-container, set on the toast.

--env-toast-edge.note: A toast's edge is the public color property --env-toast-outline.

--env-alert-tint.note: An alert's tint is the public color property --env-alert-container, set on the alert.

--env-alert-edge.note: An alert's edge is the public color property --env-alert-outline.

--env-alert-tone.note: An alert's icon color, which its dismiss button takes too, is the public color property --env-alert-icon.

--color-avatar.note: A system token named for avatars now.

--color-avatar-figure.note: A system token named for avatars now.

--color-checkbox.note: Light took the brand’s strong fill, the same color as its emphasis fill there: one role in every theme now.

--color-dialog-overlay.note: 0.7's was opaque, #1f1f1f (hsl(0 0% 12.157%) in both themes), and the dialog backdrop made it 55% opaque with --state-dialog-overlay-opacity, which is removed. The role is the scrim itself, 55% opaque: paint it as it is, since a style that applies its own opacity now applies it twice. For the opaque color, write #1f1f1f.

--color-navigation-quiet.note: The quiet navigation item’s rest, which envUI no longer reads; list items have the same fill.

--color-on-avatar.note: A system token named for avatars now.

--color-on-checkbox.note: Light took the brand’s strong fill, the same color as its emphasis fill there: one role in every theme now.

--color-row.note: A system token named for list rows: the default surface in light, the muted one in dark.

--color-row-pressed.note: A system token named for list rows: the default surface in light, the muted one in dark.

--color-switch-thumb-on.note: Light took the brand’s strong fill, the same color as its emphasis fill there: one role in every theme now.

--env-stack-gap.note: Stack is gone: Row and Column take gap as a step of the spacing scale, which they write as data-gap; set gap on your own class instead.

--env-sidebar-width.note: AppShell and Sidebar are gone: the navigation forms, Bar, Rail and Drawer, size themselves; side content goes in a Panes supporting pane.

--env-sidebar-expanded-width.note: AppShell and Sidebar are gone: the navigation forms, Bar, Rail and Drawer, size themselves; side content goes in a Panes supporting pane.

--env-sidebar-collapsed-width.note: Sidebar is gone: Rail, the navigation form for medium windows, has a width of its own.

--env-sidebar-content-width.note: Sidebar is gone: the navigation forms, Bar, Rail and Drawer, size themselves.

--env-app-divider.note: AppShell is gone, and no line sets the frame's regions apart: the navigation and the top bar fill the navigation's background, or each the page's with background="page". Panes.Divider is the gap between panes, with a grip.

--env-app-control-height.note: AppShell is gone: a TopBar with titleBar keeps the small control height.

--env-app-toggle-size.note: SidebarTrigger is gone: open a navigation drawer from an IconButton, and give it a size.

--env-split-view-gutter.note: SplitView is gone: Panes has no gutter; Panes.Divider has a width of its own.

--env-split-view-size.note: SplitView is gone: Panes takes the resized pane's size in rem, as size or defaultSize on Panes.Root.

--state-lightness-direction.note: The runtime hover rule is gone: every role has hover and pressed tokens.

--state-hover-lightness.note: The runtime hover rule is gone: use the role's -hover token.

--state-pressed-lightness.note: The runtime hover rule is gone: use the role's -pressed token.

--state-surface-hover-lightness.note: The runtime hover rule is gone: use the surface's -hover token.

--state-surface-pressed-lightness.note: The runtime hover rule is gone: use the surface's -pressed token.

--state-lightness-threshold.note: The runtime hover rule is gone.

--state-hover-shift.note: The runtime hover rule is gone.

--state-pressed-shift.note: The runtime hover rule is gone.

--state-surface-hover-shift.note: The runtime hover rule is gone.

--state-surface-pressed-shift.note: The runtime hover rule is gone.

--state-layer-hover-opacity.note: The state layer is a color token now.

--state-layer-pressed-opacity.note: The state layer is a color token now.

--state-fill-hover-opacity.note: The fill's states are color tokens now.

--state-fill-pressed-opacity.note: The fill's states are color tokens now.

--state-tone-subtle-opacity.note: Each tone has its tint as a color token: color.bg.{tone}.muted.

--state-dialog-overlay-opacity.note: The scrim is a translucent color token now.

--state-fill-opacity.note: The neutral fill is a translucent color token; layer it over a surface rather than mixing.

--scale.note: The multiplier is gone: components read sized tokens. Set scale="compact" on a Theme for the compact scale.

--toast-fill.note: Internal to the 0.7 toast. A toast takes its fill from its tone; restyle a toast through the component, not this property.

--surface-card-padding.note: Internal to the 0.7 card. Set a card's padding with its padding prop.

--app-sticky-top.note: Sticky content in a Scaffold's body sticks under its top bar, --env-scaffold-sticky-top below the window's top, where the document scrolls, and at the top of the body with scroll="body". The Scaffold sets --env-scaffold-sticky-top from its top bar's height.

--env-app-sticky-top.note: Sticky content in a Scaffold's body sticks under its top bar, --env-scaffold-sticky-top below the window's top, where the document scrolls, and at the top of the body with scroll="body". The Scaffold sets --env-scaffold-sticky-top from its top bar's height.

--env-app-topbar-block-size.note: TopBar is --env-top-bar-height tall; the Scaffold measures its top bar region and sets --env-scaffold-sticky-top from it.

--env-frame-sticky-top.note: AppShell and WindowFrame are gone: sticky content in a Scaffold's body sticks under its top bar, --env-scaffold-sticky-top below the window's top, where the document scrolls, and at the top of the body with scroll="body". The Scaffold sets --env-scaffold-sticky-top from its top bar's height.

--env-frame-header-block-size.note: AppShell and WindowFrame are gone: TopBar is --env-top-bar-height tall; the Scaffold measures its top bar region and sets --env-scaffold-sticky-top from it.

--env-app-shell-block-size.note: AppShell is gone: Scaffold fills 100dvh; give it another block-size with your own class.

--env-sidebar-inset.note: Sidebar is gone: the navigation forms, Bar, Rail and Drawer, keep their own insets.

--env-split-pane-size.note: SplitPane is gone: Panes takes the resized pane's size in rem, as size or defaultSize on Panes.Root.

--env-app-shell-header-divider.note: AppShell is gone: a TopBar draws no divider of its own; give it a border with your own class.

--env-window-frame-title-bar-left.note: WindowFrame is gone: a TopBar with titleBar keeps clear of the window's controls through --env-top-bar-title-bar-start and -end.
